description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that contains a LogView and a ScrollView, used for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages view creation, layout, and updates to the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view with scrolling capabilities, used for outputting log data.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
